# creative-engine/editor/dist — the embeddable editor bundle (Phase 4.1)

This folder is the **shippable** form of the Phase-2 portable editor: the one thing that
travels into the Kraken portal. Everything the editor needs is folded into a single file.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `creative-engine-editor.bundle.js` | **The bundle.** One self-contained ES module = editor + CSS + the shared `apply-overrides` source + the montage math. Generated by `../bundle.mjs`; do not hand-edit. |
| `embed-host.html` | A **bare** host that imports ONLY the bundle and flips it between the two lanes — the portability + permission-toggle proof, and a copy-paste template for the Kraken mount. |
| `embed-evidence.mjs` | The Phase-4.1 proof harness (drives `embed-host.html` headless; verdict below). |
| `_out/` | Reproducible evidence artifacts (gitignored). |

## Rebuild

```
node creative-engine/editor/bundle.mjs        # → dist/creative-engine-editor.bundle.js
```

The build is a deterministic string concat of our own Phase-2 files (no bundler, no
framework, zero imports from `creative-engine-v1/`). It fails loudly if any relative peer
import survives — the self-contained guarantee is checked, not assumed.

## Mount it (the contract Kraken consumes)

```html
<script type="module">
  import { mountEditor } from '.../creative-engine-editor.bundle.js';
  const ed = mountEditor({
    container,                 // a host <div>
    html,                      // the Phase-1 *tagged* design HTML (data-edit-* ids)
    baseHref,                  // the design's own folder (so its assets resolve)
    permissions: 'view',       // 'view' (client lane: read-only + Kraken's comment UI)
                               // 'edit' (agency lane: click-retype / swap / drag)
    mediaProvider: { staticLibrary, remoteBrowse },  // optional; degrades if absent
    onChange(overrides) { /* persist the override bag back to the approval row */ },
  });
  // ed.getOverrides() → { "fN:eM": {text?,src?,pos?} }   ed.setOverrides(), .destroy(), …
</script>
```

The bundle injects its own `<style>` and sets `window.__CE_APPLY_SRC__` itself on the
first `mountEditor()` call (mount time, never import time — safe under SSR). No `<link>`,
no peer fetch, no load-order trap. It also exposes `window.CreativeEngineEditor.mountEditor`
for non-module hosts.

## Phase-4.1 evidence (verified)

```
node creative-engine/editor/dist/embed-evidence.mjs
```

Drives `embed-host.html` headless against the real tagged Westfield design and checks:

```
PASS  bundle self-contained (0 peer imports)
PASS  bundle global mountEditor present
PASS  css self-injected (no host <link>)
PASS  EDIT: iframe body has ce-edit
PASS  EDIT: hint shows edit affordances
PASS  EDIT: dblclick → contenteditable
PASS  VIEW: iframe body NOT ce-edit
PASS  VIEW: hint = View only
PASS  VIEW: dblclick inert (no contenteditable)
PASS  no page errors

PHASE 4.1 EVIDENCE: PASS
```

The permission flag is proven two ways per lane: **state** (the iframe `<body>` carries
`ce-edit` + the chrome hint) and **behavior** (a real double-click makes text editable in
`edit`, inert in `view`). Screenshots land in `_out/embed-edit.png` / `_out/embed-view.png`.
